title: wlc-intercontinental
label: Hart

won.source: The promotion's own 3 January 1999 recap states Hart won the Intercontinental title tournament.

note: Lost the title weeks later after his own ally struck him with a wrench, per the promotion's own recap.

title: wlc-intercontinental
label: Spector

won.source: The promotion's own 3 January 1999 recap states Spector won the title from Hart with an ally's help.

note: Retained the title by disqualification against Hollywood Hogan on the promotion's own 6 January 1999 broadcast after the champion's own rival interfered.

title: wlc-world-heavyweight
label: Kane

won.source: The promotion's own 3 January 1999 recap states Kane won a tournament for the vacant World Heavyweight title.

note: Retained the title on 6 January 1999 in a four-way match against Stone Cold Steve Austin, Hollywood Hogan and The Rock that ended without a clean finish when Austin vanished from a locked casket mid-match.

title: wlc-hardcore
label: Kevin Nash

won.source: The federation's own first pay-per-view: Nash won a same-night tournament (defeating Mick Powers, then Scott Hall and The Rock in a three-way) to become the first WLC Hardcore Champion.

note: The last surviving document reading on this title leaves Nash still champion.
